summary: Add explicitly owned, cancellable keeper supervision (unit 7f-2)

schema.detail: No persistent schema or shared writer changes.

rules.detail: INACTIVE: no startup or production caller before 4c-2 and explicit activation. No policy values or numeric polling defaults.

compatibility.detail: KeeperWatcher owns a running idle/cgroup.events watcher, cancellation and completion descriptors, and a joined thread. Empty idle is re-seeded in the same delegated scope. Daemon-local mutation serialization prevents concurrent ensure/watch repair from publishing duplicate replacements; cross-daemon ownership remains activation's responsibility.

manual.detail: Fixtures cover cancellation, join/drop, watcher errors, concurrent ensure/repair and failed replacement cleanup. No cargo, native execution or gate-slot proof run.

recovery.detail: The watcher never launches a job or replaces its scope. Holder pidfd observation can surface watcher failure while work is running; the next part integrates this explicit supervisor beside the inactive concrete launcher.
